instructions: How much will this reader enjoy this joke?
levels: A short question-and-answer pun or one-liner. The whole joke is a play on one word, a stock riddle format, or a put-down of a group. The reader has heard this shape a hundred times and sees the answer coming.
A joke with some build-up and a workable punchline, but the pay-off is mild, familiar, or leans on a stereotype. The reader smiles and moves on.

A story of several sentences that sets up a real situation with named roles (an engineer, a manager, a captain, a new arrival at the gates of heaven), builds expectation step by step, and ends on a sharp reversal in the last line that recasts everything before it. The reader laughs and wants to retell it.
